description: June 12, 2025 – RALEIGH, N.C. — The North Carolina Department of Disabled American Veterans (DAV) recognized Representative James Roberson as the 2025 Legislator of the Year recipient at their Convention Banquet. The award highlights his ongoing commitment to supporting veterans across the state, especially those living with disabilities. “I am deeply grateful and honored […]
